subject.title: Reminder guard fires false positives on memory-related "I'll remember" statements

question: Which linked fix path should maintainers adopt for the reminder-guard matcher: refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/47589, revise https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93862, or open a narrow replacement?
rationale: The bug is clear, but two open contributor PRs already target it and differ in completeness, mergeability, and proof state, so an automated new fix lane should not race them.

options.title: Adopt the stronger linked fix path
options.body: Refresh or sponsor the linked PR that preserves the broadest genuine reminder-action coverage, require real delivered-reply proof, then close this issue after merge.

options.title: Revise the smaller candidate
options.body: Use the smaller open PR only if it is updated to preserve reminder-action phrasing and supplies real behavior proof.

options.title: Open a replacement later
options.body: If neither contributor branch can be made merge-ready, close or supersede them only after a narrow replacement PR exists.

recommendation.title: Adopt the stronger linked fix path
recommendation.body: Refresh or sponsor the linked PR that preserves the broadest genuine reminder-action coverage, require real delivered-reply proof, then close this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history ties steipete to the extracted helper and nearby reminder-guard coverage, making them the best available routing owner for choosing the landing path.
